question: Does the per-example Base-preservation hinge with weight 8 suppress the magnitude and held-out benefit of the direct H15 residual?
controlled_fields: Same Base1000, Stage1 v2, bank, task-language retrieval, action cache, train95/validation5, seed, code, 500 optimizer steps, batch256, LR5e-5, bounded H15 residual, regression/trust/gate losses and checkpoint schedule; only preserve-loss-weight changes.

readout.selection_for_closed_loop: none; the original preregistered 3%/8-task gate remains mandatory for any new candidate

interpretation: If both residual magnitude and validation improvement rise materially when only the hinge is removed, hinge suppression is supported. Otherwise inspect feature/architecture bottlenecks, especially the whole-H15 probe versus the deployed per-step head. This is a diagnostic, not a checkpoint chosen by formal success labels.
